ENGLISH — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. Only one word repeated

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

3. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only a describing word

4. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

5. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

7. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

8. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. quickly

9. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.

   A. went
   B. goed
   C. going
   D. goes

14. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the library

15. When practising Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
